product_metadata.title: Maxam Steak Knife Set - 8 7/8 Inch Stainless Steel Serrated Blade, Set of 8, Sharp Slicing Edge for Thick Meat
features: EFFORTLESS SLICING - Slice chunky meats like a hot knife through butter. This steak knife shows off a razor-sharp serrated edge, which lets you enjoy smooth and perfect cuts with minimal effort
FEELS GREAT IN YOUR HANDS - Easy to grasp, the dishwasher safe handles feature a classic, triple faux rivet design
BUILT TO LAST - Low quality steak knives tend to rust or lose their edge after just a few weeks of use. This steak knife is made of stainless steel that will withstand rust and corrosion.
description: Insist on premium quality steak knives to cut that premium steak or chop on your plate. High-performance yet beautiful on the table, the Maxam 8pc 8-7/8" Steak Knife Set has the best value by far. Easy to grasp, the dishwasher safe handles feature a classic, triple faux rivet design. Cuts like butter, whether dinner is black tie or BBQ. Excellent idea and comes in a stunning presentation box. Limited lifetime.
